focus: Diaphragmatic resistance, vagal tone, and parasympathetic recovery

exercises.name: 4-7-8 Breathing
exercises.execution: Inhale through nose for 4s, hold for 7s, exhale completely through pursed lips for 8s.
exercises.benefit: Builds CO2 tolerance to expand lung capacity; forcefully lowers heart rate via the vagus nerve.

exercises.name: Thoracic Windmills
exercises.execution: Stand wide, hinge at hips. Left hand on right knee, reach right arm up to ceiling. Twist, follow hand with eyes, hold 3s. Alternate.
exercises.benefit: Pries open the compressed ribcage, creating mechanical space for maximum lung expansion.

exercises.name: Deep Runner’s Lunge
exercises.execution: Deep forward lunge, both hands inside front foot, back knee on floor. Sink hips down.
exercises.benefit: Releases hip flexors/psoas, allowing pooled blood to return to the lower body and relieving heart pumping strain.

exercises.name: Crocodile Breathing
exercises.execution: Lie face down flat. Forehead on stacked hands. Nose-breathe, forcing stomach hard against the floor.
exercises.benefit: Acts as weightlifting for respiratory muscles; builds genuine lung strength and forces deep nervous system recovery.
